title: The scope of an existing insight is narrowed
turns: I'm about to start the edit for my last trip. Can you pull up what I have written about batching photos by theme?

Right. After the last two trips I've settled on a narrower rule: batching by theme only saved time for the landscape and street shots. For portraits I now edit each photo on its own, because skin tones need individual care. Everything else in that note still holds.
recall_turn: How should I approach editing my trip photos, and where does batching by theme help?
